issues.problem: Process-global bank is never cleared (not on bake, not on failed run). A later EaglesRenderer.render in the same process on a different run's params (same q_* field names) while a stale un-baked bank is active would silently decode with the wrong decoders and render at the stale progressive scale if grad is enabled. Not reachable via ss-train/ss-eval (fresh process; runtime has no resume; initialize overwrites ACTIVE; baked bank is bypassed).
issues.evidence: decoders.ACTIVE set in density.initialize only; renderer.active_bank checks only bank.baked and field names
issues.fix: Clear ACTIVE on bake and on exception, or bind the bank to the params dict identity / a weakref and ignore it for other params.

issues.problem: Runtime takes the latent optimizer step and the decoder step also at the final step; official skips the optimizer step at iteration == iterations. One-step difference, negligible.

Transcription of supp. Table 2 is faithful, but the paper's own Average row is not the mean of its per-scene rows (PSNR 27.23 vs mean 27.19, storage 54 MB vs mean 59.9 MB). Compare per-scene, not against the average, for the storage target.
issues.evidence: recomputed from per_scene: psnr 27.186, storage 59.889, gaussians 1.326M

issues.problem: gsplat DefaultStrategy also runs its own reset_opa on the mirrored base `opacities` at multiples of 2500. It is harmless only because _mirror() overwrites it afterwards in the same call (and the opacities optimizer has no gradients); worth an explicit comment/probe.
issues.fix: Set base reset_every above total_steps or keep the mirror-after-events invariant under test.
